title: Crossing
description: Two plans on lanes that are not declared adjacent, one east-west and one north-south, crossing over the shared node at t=10 s at the same height. The corridor inspection sees no relation between the lanes; the crossing inspection does.
what_this_does_not_prove: That every crossing of two corridors is detected: the inspection compares arrival times at a shared planar point, so two lanes that merely converge without their tracks crossing are caught only by the sweep or the corridor test.
Anything about conflict after the node - it proves the checker can name the contested point, not that the corridor needs a reserved crossing volume.
